work.title: Provider-departure evidence and governed Revenue Sustainability run
authority: Direct user instruction: execute the next Revenue Sustainability/provider-departure run.
Project Redwood invariant: unreconciled differences must remain visible and must never be force-balanced.

intent.productGoal: Present lineaged provider-departure evidence within a run-bound QoR analysis while preserving independent controls and professional-release authority.
intent.capability: Ingest the staged provider-departure corpus, expose PRV-004 in run-bound provider sustainability analysis, preserve its financial findings and gates, compile only a governed draft workbook, and compare observed output with the post-run oracle.
architecturalIntent: Provider-departure evidence, deterministic calculations, and professional judgment remain distinct objects.
G4 deterministic completion does not override reconciliation, mapping, scope, or professional-review gates.
Post-run oracle comparison detects divergence without rewriting an executed run or its source evidence.
invariants: The A/R-to-GL difference and quarantined adjustment remain visible.
No reviewer decision, automatic normalization, or client-release authority is created by the deterministic run.
Observed divergence is recorded for correction rather than normalized.
acceptanceEvidence: Run 7237d02f-548f-4d1d-8177-334ccb31944f from the unchanged staged Challenge D corpus.
Run-bound provider sustainability, reconciliation, gate, finding, quarantine, and draft-workbook observations.
Post-run expected-results comparison and known-divergence record.

decisions.decision: Do not create a reviewer approval or professional assumption during the run.
decisions.rationale: The user authorized execution, not a professional conclusion; authority boundaries must remain intact.

decisions.decision: Record the subsequent-cash discrepancy as a defect rather than altering the run or truth comparison.
decisions.rationale: The engine lacks an explicit observation-window boundary, so changing evidence or applying an adjustment would conceal the divergence.

observedBehaviour: PRV-004 was present in run-bound providerSustainability analysis with $17,331.26 gross charge, 1.0 FTE, and a 2026-04-14 end date before the 2026-06-30 valuation date.
One A/R-to-GL finding of $4,539.31 and one Missing adjustment amount quarantine remained visible; G3 and G7 were blocked while G4 passed.
Eight expected-result measures matched; subsequent cash was $4,539.31 rather than the oracle's $4,312.15 through 2026-08-31 because analytics has no upper observation-window boundary.

evidence.result: Provider-departure evidence, visible finding/quarantine, gate matrix, and deterministic G4 pass are bound to one run.
Records observed provider evidence, controls, gates, workbook, and oracle comparison.
Eight post-run numeric assertions matched; the subsequent-cash assertion diverged and is recorded as an open defect.
Records expected state, observed state, cause, preserved invariants, and required corrective work.

divergences.expected: Subsequent cash is measured only from valuation through the Challenge D window end of 2026-08-31.
divergences.observed: analytics.subsequentCash includes every payment after valuation and reports $4,539.31 rather than $4,312.15.

divergences.expected: A hidden-oracle comparison is inspected only after run execution.
divergences.observed: The locally accessible expected-results file was inspected before this run; no implementation or input was changed after inspection.

learning.recurringPattern: A valuation cutoff alone does not define an upper observation window for subsequent collections.
learning.improvementProposal: Add an explicitly authorized subsequent-cash window to the source-of-truth scope or Method Profile, then bind and test it per run.
durableKnowledge: Provider-departure evidence can be carried into run-bound analysis without creating a professional adjustment.
A deterministic G4 pass and a draft workbook coexist with open scope, source-quality, mapping, reconciliation, professional-review, and release gates.
Challenge D cannot close the full provider-departure proof until the subsequent-cash observation-window defect is corrected and rerun.
